title: API Keys And Personal Access Tokens Semantic Contract
description: Source-backed draft semantic contract for the api keys personal access tokens capability, derived from historical React evidence as lineage. Facets cite verified source-import manifest rows; proof is hermetic/runtime lineage and not fresh USF proof.
aiGuidance: Source-backed draft. Facets cite verified manifest source rows as lineage; proof is hermetic/stale and not current readiness. Do not treat as implementation authority or fresh proof; respect the hexagonal constraint in ADR 0005.

lifecycle.description: Create returns the plaintext secret once; list returns metadata only; authenticate validates a live non-revoked key; revoke sets revokedAt.

stateModel.description: Active vs revoked keys with prefix, scopes, salted hash; the plaintext secret is never persisted.

permissions.description: tenant.api_keys.read/write and platform.api_keys.read; creation requires the api_access entitlement, deny-by-default.

contracts.description: Org-scoped create/list/delete and operator read of tenant keys behind ports/adapters.

validation.description: Tenants without api_access are rejected; invalid ids rejected; wrong/garbage secrets never authenticate; cross-tenant listing denied.

errorModel.description: not_entitled and validation outcomes; revoked/wrong/malformed secrets authenticate as null.

auditModel.description: api_key.created and api_key.revoked are audited before the change; a failing audit aborts before storage.

readinessModel.description: Runtime proofs verify crypto, RLS isolation, and routes; skip honestly when the substrate is unavailable.

proof.description: Unit and runtime proof of key lifecycle and routes. Demonstrated in React via hermetic/runtime proof lineage; fresh USF proof pending USF-101/USF-59.

uiSemanticDefinition.description: No verified UI source path in the manifest yet; author the UI semantic model or import the UI source row before generation.
